title: Static Broad-Rostrum Horizontal-Fluke Whale
description: One newly drawn whole stylised whale-like exterior: a broad blunt flattened rostrum blends through a massive rounded head and deep arched trunk into a slender raised tail stock. Two long thick curved-outline pectoral flippers sweep beside the front body; one low swept dorsal rises posteriorly. A single complete wide horizontal tail fluke has two broad lateral lobes and a true open central trailing V notch. Small lateral eyes and pale lower body aid reading. Entire body sections and flipper/fluke outlines are new, not a hammerhead with tail rotated, old seal with hind flippers joined, or fish enlarged. One static animal prop, zero scenes; finite low belly datum for game placement only. No exact species, internal organs, blowhole/respiration/feeding, swimming, buoyancy, biological behaviour, rig, animation or interaction claim.
